question: Test fixed linear odd flux coupling as a preparation-independent fold trigger.
assumptions: Empty odd records and flat net on the upward branch.
Fixed linear signed flux-to-hinge velocity for the no-go.
Common odd phase for pure-pair coverage.
target_exposure: First directed half-stock hold target established in C06 v0.16–v0.17
fitted_choices: Kinematic and torque controls declared; normalized candidate enforces the known target; no empirical fit
baseline: C06 v0.18 signed odd flux and v0.25 constraint
result: Fixed linear routing closes at half stock for every common-phase share at one stock only if it uses total flux. The gain then scales inversely with stock. Normalized phase locking is candidate only.
next_discriminant: Derive or falsify a native source of normalized phase locking and same-event authority.
